title: JobRequest
description: One container to run. The same object is the body of POST /v1/jobs, a task in a poll answer, and the body of a manifest. Unknown fields are rejected with 400 {"error":"invalid JSON"}. A null value is the same as leaving the field out, except for env, which must be an object when present. Lengths are checked in bytes by the runner; maxLength here counts characters, so keep to ASCII where a limit matters. Whether a valid request is accepted still depends on the machine: its allowlist, its max_timeout_secs, its free slots and its drain flag.

image.description: The image to pull and run. Lowercase, no whitespace or control characters, no '..' or '//', does not start with '-' or end with ':'. On a push it must match the machine's allowlist (403 otherwise). A polled task skips the allowlist only when the machine sets poll_any_image.

job_key.description: Idempotency key on this one machine. While a job with this key is in the machine's history, the same key returns that job and starts nothing, whatever the rest of the request says.

env.description: Environment of the container. Opaque strings: the runner does not read, interpret or log them. At most 128 variables. A value is at most 16384 bytes and holds no NUL.

command.description: Docker Cmd: replaces the image's default command, not its entrypoint. Omitted, null or [] runs the image as built. An argument holds no NUL.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds the container may run, counted from its start, then SIGKILL. The image pull has the same limit of its own. Default: the machine's default_timeout_secs (3600). Above the machine's max_timeout_secs (21600 by default, never above 604800) is a 400. Write it as an integer, with no fraction.

cpu.description: CPU limit in cores, such as 0.5 or 2. No limit when omitted.

memory.description: Memory limit. Swap is set to the same value. Without it Docker does not cap the container.

shm.description: Size of /dev/shm. Docker's default (64 MiB) when omitted.

callback_url.description: Receives one POST with the JobResult when the job ends. http or https with a host. No header is added to that request, so a secret for it goes in the URL.

byteQuantity.description: A positive integer number of bytes, or a string with a binary unit: b, k, kb, kib, m, mb, mib, g, gb, gib, in either case. Every unit is a power of 1024. '512m', '1.5g', '2GiB'. A JSON number with a fraction is rejected; write it as a string.
